$comment: Locale registry (schema: localeFileSchema in src/schemas/index.ts). Adding a locale is a configuration change: add an entry here, add src/i18n/<code>/*.json and src/content/**/<code>/*.mdx. status: planned = validated but not built; preview = built with English fallback, noindex, banner; published = must be complete, indexed, in hreflang. jurisdictions: full = the countries (or EU) this locale covers in full, in display order (regulatory rows, products, approval answers, contact cards); notes = short notes only (contact cards); WADA is shown everywhere and never listed. Every other jurisdiction's data stays in src/data/ but is not shown in this locale. printsEmergencyNumbers: false = the locale says 'call your local emergency number' and never prints a number.
